name: word replace
description: The `replaceEmoji` function is designed to replace a word in the text with an emoji within a text editor. It logs the emoji, extracts necessary cursor information, slices the text before and after the word, and then reassembles the text with the emoji in place of the word using `setEditorText`. The cursor position is updated to follow the emoji insertion. The importance of using absolute file paths and ensuring integration with related components like `this.editor?.innerText` and `cursorWord` settings is emphasized.
